title: Lab 4A — S3 lifecycle + cost
topic: S3 storage classes and lifecycle transitions, Intelligent-Tiering vs IA, Glacier retrieval, Cost Explorer vs Budgets vs CUR, GSA iceland/ prefix archiving, MPU abort, cost pillar traps
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-30-s3-lifecycle-cost.md and gsa-s3-lifecycle-map.md. Answer without peeking at night-30-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas stores monthly Iceland pipeline output under globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-output/iceland/YYYY-MM/. Runs older than 90 days are read at most once per quarter; after one year they are pure archive. Which automation fits with minimal ops?

options.A: Manually change storage class in the console each month per prefix
options.B: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the bucket for all PUT operations
options.C: S3 lifecycle rules on the iceland/ prefix transitioning to Standard-IA then Glacier by age
options.D: Migrate all objects to EBS gp3 volumes attached to the ECS task

questions.question: You create a lifecycle rule to transition objects from S3 Standard to Standard-IA after 1 day. Objects uploaded yesterday remain Standard today. What exam concept explains the delay?

options.A: Intelligent-Tiering requires 90 days before any move
options.B: Minimum storage duration — objects must remain in the current class for at least 30 days before transition
options.C: Glacier Vault Lock prevents transitions until legal hold expires
options.D: S3 lifecycle runs only on the first Sunday of each month

questions.question: A new analytics prefix has unpredictable access — some objects hot for weeks, others cold for months. You want AWS to move tiers automatically without guessing Standard vs IA upfront. Which storage class?

options.A: S3 Intelligent-Tiering with a small per-object monitoring fee
options.B: S3 Glacier Deep Archive for all new uploads
options.C: S3 One Zone-IA because it is always cheaper than Standard
options.D: EBS sc1 attached to a Lambda function for object storage

questions.question: Your study account needs an email when forecasted monthly spend exceeds 80% of a $25 cap. Which service sends that notification?

options.A: AWS Cost and Usage Report delivered to S3 nightly
options.B: Amazon CloudWatch alarm on the S3 NumberOfObjects metric
options.C: AWS Cost Explorer saved report with no alerting
options.D: AWS Budgets with ACTUAL or FORECASTED threshold notifications

questions.question: Finance wants hourly line-item billing exports to a data lake for custom SQL in Athena. Which cost tool is purpose-built?

options.A: S3 Storage Lens dashboard only — no export
options.B: AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) published to S3
options.C: AWS Budgets with SNS fan-out to three SQS queues
options.D: Amazon Macie classification jobs on the billing console

questions.question: Reproducible pipeline artifacts can be rebuilt from source if one Availability Zone fails. You want the cheapest infrequent-access S3 tier and accept AZ-level risk. Which class?

options.A: S3 One Zone-IA — lower cost than Standard-IA, data in a single AZ
options.B: S3 Standard with cross-Region replication to three Regions
options.C: S3 Glacier Deep Archive with instant retrieval
options.D: Amazon EFS Standard across all AZs in the Region

questions.question: After lifecycle moves old compliance PDFs to Glacier Flexible Retrieval, auditors request a 200 GB restore. Storage cost dropped, but finance sees a new charge. What happened?

options.A: Lifecycle automatically upgrades objects to S3 Standard on GET
options.B: Glacier eliminates all retrieval fees — charge must be a bug
options.C: Glacier retrieval is billed separately from archive storage — lifecycle does not remove restore costs
options.D: AWS Budgets charges $0.10 per lifecycle transition event

questions.question: Multipart uploads to a pipeline bucket stall during network outages, leaving incomplete uploads that accrue storage charges. Which lifecycle element fixes this with no manual sweeper?

options.A: S3 Object Lock in compliance mode for 7 days
options.B: Cross-Region Replication to a second bucket
options.C: S3 Inventory report delivered weekly to SNS

questions.question: You intended to archive iceland/2025-* prefixes but accidentally set the lifecycle filter to icland/ (typo). Six months later old pipeline data is still Standard. What failed?

options.A: Glacier requires objects larger than 128 KiB — small GeoJSON skipped
options.B: Lifecycle prefix filters are exact — typo meant no objects matched the rule
options.C: Standard-IA cannot be targeted by lifecycle — only Glacier can
options.D: Cost Explorer must approve transitions before S3 executes them

questions.question: The Iceland ECS task finished this morning and uploaded iceland/2026-07/ output. Downstream workers may re-read those objects all week. Which storage class should they remain in immediately after upload?

options.A: S3 Standard — frequent access, millisecond retrieval, no IA retrieval surcharge
options.B: S3 Glacier Deep Archive — lowest storage cost for brand-new data
options.C: S3 One Zone-IA — always correct for any object younger than 30 days
options.D: EC2 Instance Store — durable system of record for pipeline output

questions.question: A versioned bucket keeps overwritten wiki exports. You want lifecycle to move only older noncurrent versions to Standard-IA after 30 days. What must be true?

options.A: Bucket must use S3 Object Lambda access points
options.B: S3 Transfer Acceleration must be enabled on the bucket
options.C: Bucket versioning enabled and NoncurrentVersionTransitions defined in lifecycle
options.D: AWS Backup plan must wrap the bucket — lifecycle cannot touch versions

questions.question: Cost Explorer shows Amazon EC2-Other (NAT Gateway) dominates the study VPC bill while S3 storage is under $1. Which cost optimization aligns with Nights 8–10?

options.A: Transition all S3 objects to Glacier Deep Archive immediately
options.B: Add VPC gateway endpoints for S3 (and interface endpoints for ECR) to reduce NAT-processed egress
options.C: Replace S3 with EBS io2 volumes for Iceland output
options.D: Disable S3 Block Public Access to avoid NAT charges

questions.question: A junior engineer proposes a lifecycle expiration rule deleting iceland/ objects after 400 days — the only copy in one Region, no replication, no AWS Backup. What is the primary architecture risk?

options.A: Expiration is free — no risk if objects are old
options.B: Glacier Flexible Retrieval cannot be expired — rule will fail
options.C: Intelligent-Tiering will block expiration until monitoring fee is paid
options.D: Permanent data loss if no replica — expiration is not DR; pair with replication or backup first

questions.question: Legal requires 7-year retention of rarely accessed audit logs with retrieval acceptable after half a day. Lowest storage cost is the priority. Which Glacier tier?

options.A: S3 Glacier Deep Archive — lowest $/GB; retrieval in hours
options.B: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval — ms access like Standard
options.C: S3 Standard-IA — cheapest option for all archive workloads
options.D: S3 Intelligent-Tiering Frequent Access tier only

questions.question: Night 30 applies lifecycle to iceland/ prefixes on globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-output. Where does durable Iceland pipeline output live before any transition — per Nights 10, 27, and 29?

options.A: Attached EBS gp3 volume on the Fargate task — lifecycle moves blocks to Glacier
options.B: ElastiCache Redis — lifecycle flushes cache keys to S3
options.C: S3 object keys under the pipeline bucket — EBS/Instance Store is scratch only on compute
options.D: Aurora resort_stats table — S3 lifecycle applies to SQL rows automatically
